questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very. I've studied Korea studies for years

questions.answer: Because I only took courses made for exchange students, I didn't really have any oportunities to talk to the Korean students. I made some Korean friends through different mobile apps and the internet

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Koreans walk really slowly. They look at you, because you're not Korean

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: More or less everything

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be open, use the Korean you know (if you know any) and don't be afraid to ask for help

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The NHIS for exchange students. You have to have unlimited insurance from home to not have to pay it. You can get your insurance from home to write a paper that says it's unlimited, but the paper has to have your birthday on it. If you pay the NHIS insurance, just go to the convenience store at campus to do it
